name: 1176LN Rev E
notes: Probed 2026-11-23. Input, output, attack and release report raw knob numbers (0-32767), so they're read from the display through a measured table. They're 1176-family controls: input/output in the 1176's dB, attack/release as knob positions 1-7. They carry between the 1176 FET, 1176AE and 1176LN Rev E only.
Power stands in for the compressor's in/out. Two ratio buttons in read as the higher ratio; None (no button) reads as 1:1.
